name: mcal_add_meeting
description: Attach a video meeting (a Metalcraft Meet room) to an event by `id` in calendar `calendar` — like adding Google Meet to an event. Provisions a room for the event's current guests, stores the join URL on the event (and in its location), and returns the event including `meeting_join_url` and its guest list. Idempotent (returns the existing meeting if one is attached). Requires the write scope. Add the guests first (mcal_add_guests) so they're seeded into the room. If it returns 503, meetings aren't configured on the server.

id.description: Event id (UUID) to add a meeting to.
